# Third-party code

`analysis/matlab/s06_mmd_test.m` uses `mmd.m` and `rbf_dot.m` from the dataset and code released with

Karagoz, O. K., Kilic, A., Aydin, E. Y., Ankarali, M. M., Uyanik, I. (2024).
*Dataset and Code for the Article: Predictive Uncertainty in State-Estimation Drives Active Sensing.*
Aperta, TUBITAK ULAKBIM. https://aperta.ulakbim.gov.tr/records/274062
Licence: Creative Commons Attribution-ShareAlike 4.0 International (CC BY-SA 4.0).

Place `mmd.m` and `rbf_dot.m` (from the `utilities` folder of that archive) in this folder.
Anything copied from the archive keeps its CC BY-SA 4.0 licence and must carry the attribution above.
The files are not included here.
